name: Profile stats header
oneLiner: a full-width light profile header (lit brand banner, real face in a ring, name, handle, bio, three stats) drifts in slow 3D; the follower count rolls like an odometer, every digit spinning to its new value, and lands with a green gain chip
say: when the speaker talks about audience growth ('I went from under 10K to over 10K in a month', 'this account grew by 400 in a day'): cut in on the build-up, the odometer rolls as they say the number and the gain chip lands on it. Set followersFrom and followers to the real before and after
